submission.natural_language_explanation: A broad, dense dial that peaks on the distinguishing word of the second member of a contrastive or parallel pair: the token that names the counterpart of something already mentioned (off- after on-resonant, right-eye after left-eye, mixed after pure states, chrominance after luminance, converted after non-converted, South Kivu after North Kivu, (1-P) after P, min after max, SHAM after lesioned) and, more weakly, the next item opened by enumerating/exemplifying words (such as, like, both, just the, later numbers in a list). The same word with no earlier counterpart in context, and head nouns that close a phrase, are much weaker.
